name: USA Travel & Holiday Events 2026: Official Field Dataset

properties.name: urn:ogc:def:crs:OGC:1.3:CRS84
Chicago Christkindlmarket (Daley Plaza)
properties.description: The gold standard of American German Christmas markets since 1996. Handcrafted timber huts beneath Picasso's sculpture featuring Käthe Wohlfahrt baubles, hot Glühwein, and annual collector mugs.

properties.name: Bank of America Winter Village at Bryant Park
properties.address: 40th to 42nd St between 5th & 6th Ave, New York, NY 10018
properties.description: Manhattan's premier holiday village behind the NYPL Schwarzman Building. Over 170 custom glass artisan kiosks surrounding a 17,000-sq-ft free-admission outdoor skating rink and The Lodge.

properties.name: Union Square Holiday Market
properties.address: Union Square Park, E 14th St, New York, NY 10003
properties.description: Internationally acclaimed holiday artisan fair in Manhattan. Winding timber aisles of handmade crafts, fine jewelry, artisanal hot chocolate, and organic pantry provisions.

properties.name: Rockefeller Center Christmas Tree & Rink
properties.description: The quintessential American Christmas spectacle since 1931. A towering 75-90ft Norway Spruce crowned with a Swarovski star overlooking Prometheus and the iconic ice rink.

properties.name: Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade
properties.address: Central Park West & 77th St to 34th St Herald Sq, New York, NY 10001
properties.description: Historic 2.5-mile procession celebrating its centennial era. Monumental helium character balloons, Broadway performances, marching bands, and Santa's official herald into Manhattan.

properties.name: Seattle Christmas Market at Fisher Pavilion
properties.description: Pacific Northwest German-inspired holiday festival beneath the Space Needle. Authentic wooden huts, glittering walk-in Christmas tree, Christmas carousel, and Bavarian culinary delicacies.

properties.name: San Antonio River Walk Holiday Lights & Ford Parade
properties.address: 849 E Commerce St, San Antonio, TX 78205
properties.description: Over 100,000 sparkling LED lights draped across monumental bald cypress trees along the subterranean river canal. Illuminated river barge parade with mariachi and costumed river carols.

properties.name: Seattle Pike Place Market Magic in the Market
properties.description: Historic nine-acre public market holiday ceremony. Fresh evergreen wreaths, craft makers, flying fish, live brass quartets, and the annual lighting of the iconic market clock and clock tower.

properties.name: Red Rocks Park & Amphitheatre Winter Circuit
properties.description: World-famous 6,450-foot sandstone amphitheatre framed by Ship Rock and Creation Rock with sweeping snow-covered panoramic views of Denver's skyline and crisp mountain morning stair circuits.

properties.name: Central Park Bethesda Terrace & Bow Bridge
properties.address: 72nd St Transverse, Central Park, New York, NY 10024
properties.description: Vaux and Olmsted's architectural masterpiece. Ornate Minton encaustic tiled ceiling arches, Angel of the Waters fountain, and Victorian cast-iron Bow Bridge over the Lake.

properties.name: Natchitoches Christmas Festival
properties.description: Celebrating its centennial year as one of America's oldest holiday traditions. Over 300,000 brilliant lights and 100+ riverbank set pieces illuminating historic Cane River Lake.

properties.name: Dyker Heights Christmas Lights
properties.address: 11th to 13th Ave & 83rd to 86th St, Brooklyn, NY 11228
properties.description: World-famous residential extravaganza featuring monumental 30-foot motorized nutcrackers, life-sized animatronic reindeer, and millions of dazzling lumens in Brooklyn.

properties.name: Boston Public Library McKim Building Courtyard
properties.description: Charles Follen McKim's 1895 Renaissance revival palace of learning on Copley Square. Arcaded granite courtyard, Bates Hall green banker's lamps, and murals by John Singer Sargent.

properties.name: Reading Terminal Market Holiday Showcase
properties.description: America's oldest continuously operating farmers market since 1893. Pennsylvania Dutch baked goods, hot turkey platters, seasonal model train tracks, and festive brass bands.

properties.name: San Francisco Ferry Building Holiday Market
properties.description: 1898 beaux-arts ferry terminal overlooking San Francisco Bay and Bay Bridge. Celebrated artisanal food purveyors, outdoor organic citrus and holiday craft farmers market.

properties.name: Gateway Arch National Park Riverfront Winter Loop
properties.description: Eero Saarinen's 630-foot stainless steel arch towering over the Mississippi River. Subterranean Museum of Westward Expansion, tram ride to the crest, and landscaped park paths.

properties.name: Griffith Observatory & Mount Hollywood Trail
properties.address: 2800 E Observatory Rd, Los Angeles, CA 90027
properties.dates: Year-round, winter golden hours November – February
properties.description: 1935 Art Deco cultural icon perched on Mount Hollywood. Historic Zeiss telescope viewing, Samuel Oschin Planetarium, and sweeping sunset panoramas of the Los Angeles basin.

properties.name: Balboa Park Historic Plaza & Botanical Building
properties.category: Historic Cultural Park & Spanish Colonial Revival
properties.dates: Year-round, December Nights festival early December
properties.description: 1,200-acre cultural oasis created for the 1915 Panama-California Exposition. Ornate Spanish Colonial churrigueresque facades, restored 1915 wood-lath Botanical Building, and lily pond.

properties.name: Bellagio Conservatory & Botanical Gardens
properties.address: 3600 S Las Vegas Blvd, Las Vegas, NV 89109
properties.description: A 14,000-sq-ft glass conservatory showcasing magnificent seasonal botanical displays with tens of thousands of fresh flowers, paired with choreographed musical fountain water ballets.

properties.name: Garden of the Gods Perkins Central Garden
properties.description: National Natural Landmark featuring 300-foot vertical red sandstone rock formations dramatically contrasted against snow-covered Pikes Peak. Crisp alpine walking loops and geology center.
